name: Turbo Templates Kit for Elementor
author: Turbo Addons

sections.description:
Turbo Templates Kit for Elementor is a powerful template library and no code website builder solution for WordPress. Professional Elementor Templates Library with 200+ ready-made website templates, full website kits, starter sites, and no-code website builder tools for WordPress. Build complete websites in minutes with few-click full site import.

Why Choose Turbo Templates Kit?

  • 200+ professionally designed website templates
  • Full Website Import in one click
  • Complete Website Kits and Starter Sites
  • Faster Website Builder for WordPress
  • No Code Website Builder experience
  • Fully compatible with Elementor
  • Mobile responsive and SEO-friendly designs
  • Landing pages, inner pages, headers, footers, and popups included
  • Regular template updates and new additions
  • Free and Premium templates available
  • Fast and lightweight importing process
  • Translation ready
  • Secure coding standards
  • WP-CLI support
  • REST API integration

Features

  • Few click to full website import
  • Complete website kits with multiple pages
  • Professional website template library
  • Starter templates for multiple industries
  • Elementor template kit support
  • AI-powered website building tools
  • Faster website creation workflow
  • Responsive designs for all devices
  • SEO-friendly layouts
  • Easy customization after import
  • Security hardening with input sanitization
  • Output escaping for XSS prevention
  • WordPress coding standards compliance
  • Translation-ready architecture
  • Regular template updates

Template Categories

  • Landing Pages
  • Business
  • Portfolio
  • Blog
  • eCommerce
  • Agency
  • Non-Profit
  • Technology
  • Digital Marketing
  • SaaS
  • Transportation
  • Consulting
  • Education
  • Health & Medical
  • Personal Branding

Perfect For

  • Freelancers
  • Agencies
  • Small Businesses
  • Web Designers
  • Developers
  • Bloggers
  • Entrepreneurs
  • WooCommerce Store Owners
  • No-Code Website Creators

What Makes Turbo Templates Kit Different?

Turbo Templates Kit is designed for users who want to build professional websites faster without coding. Instead of importing individual pages, you can import complete website kits including home pages, about pages, service pages, contact pages, headers, footers, and global design settings with just a few clicks.

Whether you’re a freelancer, agency, business owner, or beginner, Turbo Templates Kit helps you launch complete websites quickly using Elementor and Turbo Addons.

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • Elementor (required for Elementor templates)
  • Turbo Addons (Required for Turbo Templates)
  • Turbo Addons Pro (Recommended )
  • == Installation ==
  1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/turbo-library-for-elementor/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Open Turbo Templates Kit from the WordPress dashboard
  4. Browse the template library
  5. Import any template with a single click
  6. Customize using Elementor

External Services

This plugin connects to external services to provide template library functionality. No personal user data is transmitted unless required for license activation.

1. Template Library Service

  • Service: Turbo Templates API
  • Purpose: Retrieves available templates, template metadata, and demo content for the template library.
  • Data Sent: Template ID, template type, pagination parameters, authentication tokens (non-personal system keys).
  • When Sent: While browsing templates, viewing previews, or importing templates.
  • Service URL: https://templates.wp-turbo.com/
  • Terms of Service & Privacy Policy: https://templates.wp-turbo.com/terms

2. Demo Content Hosting

  • Service: Turbo Addons Demo Content
  • Purpose: Hosts demo website content for preview and import functionality.
  • Data Sent: Requests for demo content files and standard User-Agent information.
  • When Sent: During template preview and import actions.
  • Service URL: https://demo.turbo-addons.com/
  • Terms of Service & Privacy Policy: https://demo.turbo-addons.com/privacy-terms/

3. License Verification Service

  • Service: Turbo License API
  • Purpose: Verifies and manages premium template licenses.
  • Data Sent: License key, site URL, plugin version.
  • When Sent: During activation, validation, and license status checks.
  • Privacy Policy: https://turbo-addons.com/privacy-policy/
  • Terms of Service: https://turbo-addons.com/terms

Note: All communications are handled through the WordPress HTTP API using secure requests and appropriate timeouts. An internet connection is required to access the template library.

License

sections.faq:
What is Turbo Templates Kit?

Turbo Templates Kit is a WordPress template library that provides professionally designed Elementor templates, starter websites, and landing pages that can be imported instantly.

Do I need Elementor to use this plugin?

Many templates are built specifically for Elementor. Elementor must be installed and activated to use Elementor-based templates. Some content may also work with the WordPress block editor.

Is this a No Code Website Builder?

Yes. Turbo Templates Kit helps users build professional WordPress websites without writing code by importing ready-made templates and customizing them visually.

Are the templates free?

The plugin includes free templates. Additional premium templates are available with a valid license.

Can I customize imported templates?

Absolutely. All imported templates can be fully customized using Elementor’s drag-and-drop editor.

Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes. Turbo Templates Kit is designed to work with most modern WordPress themes, although it is optimized for use with Elementor-compatible themes.
